sentences.en: We cannot separate the sheep from the goats by appearance.
sentences.zh: 我们不能仅凭外表就把绵羊和山羊分开。

sentences.en: The oil in mayonnaise sometimes separates from the other ingredients.
sentences.zh: 蛋黄酱中的油有时会与其他成分分离开来。

sentences.en: It seems that the government wants to separate these three.
sentences.zh: 似乎政府想把这三者分开。

senses.zh: 单独的；分开的；不同的；各自的
